newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt paper mkt value 330 trln rbls on Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt paper mkt value 330 trln rbls on Aug 1.

text.p: The Russian government securities market value rose to 329.75 trillion roubles ($56.86 billion) on August 1 from 302.52 trillion roubles on July 25, the central bank said on Monday.

The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 249.38 trillion roubles from 246.52 trillion roubles. The market value of the OFZ interest-bearing bonds was 80.36 trillion roubles after 55.99 trillion roubles, the bank said in a statement.
The nominal value of the government paper market rose to 352.75 trillion roubles from 318.91 trillion roubles, it said.
